claim: A master that takes one turn per incoming message spends more time and far more output on relay than on the person's own requests.

metric.what: Master turns classified by what started them (person's prompt, mail, background job); characters of visible text produced per class.

countedFrom.machine: one Windows 11 machine; one master, 8 orchestrators, about 50 short-lived workers, one person
versions: agent harness as installed in the period (exact version not recorded)

proposedChange: The master reads mail in batches and writes the person one digest per batch: what changed, what needs the person. Reports that change nothing for the person are filed, not shown.
whyItGeneralises: Any coordinator that takes one turn per message pays for each turn's context and output; batching is the general remedy for per-message overhead.
